"""Back up only the fingerprinted PF2-Dev game database after explicit approval."""
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,stat,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path("/home/evennia/testing/fusion2")
TASK=Path("/home/evennia/testing/.remaining-items-20261026-2259c9")
BEFORE="b13c43953451970cce68f2a47829e261ef9a7346"
CANDIDATE="4347e76b046d2c59bd8bcf1eabe3535ebeaa95a9"
def secure_open(path):
    """Never overwrite a prior backup or expose it to other users."""
    return os.fdopen(os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600),"wb")
if __name__=="__main__":
    assert sys.argv[1:]==["--backup-approved"]
    assert Path.cwd().resolve()==ROOT and TASK.resolve()==TASK
    approval=json.loads((TASK/"operator-approval.json").read_text())
    assert approval["approved"] is True and approval["candidate"]==CANDIDATE
    reviewed=(TASK/"reviewed-plan.json").read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(reviewed).hexdigest()==approval["reviewed_plan_sha256"]
    plan=json.loads(reviewed)
    assert plan["candidate"]==CANDIDATE and plan["scope"]==approval["scope"]
    for name,item in plan["controllers"].items():
        path=TASK/name
        assert path.resolve().parent==TASK
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n",b"\n")).hexdigest()==item["sha256_lf"]
    assert approval["scope"]=="PF2-Dev remaining item release, Pokemon0059, ten finite sources and separate tagged ordinary QA only"
    assert stat.S_IMODE(TASK.stat().st_mode)==0o700
    assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()==BEFORE
    assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain"],cwd=ROOT,text=True)
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
    os.environ["DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE"]="server.conf.settings"
    os.environ["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"]="1"
    import django
    django.setup()
    from django.db import connection,transaction
    assert connection.vendor=="postgresql"
    with transaction.atomic():
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY")
            cursor.execute("SELECT current_database(),current_user,current_schema(),inet_server_addr()::text,inet_server_port()")
            identity=cursor.fetchone()
            cursor.execute("SELECT pg_database_size(current_database())")
            database_bytes=cursor.fetchone()[0]
    assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identity).encode()).hexdigest()==approval["database_fingerprint_sha256"]
    assert shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free >= 2*database_bytes+1024**3
    params=connection.get_connection_params()
    driver=connection.connection
    resolved=driver.get_dsn_parameters() if hasattr(driver,"get_dsn_parameters") else driver.info.dsn_parameters
    params.update({key:resolved[key] for key in ("host","port","user") if key in resolved})
    env=os.environ.copy()
    for key in ("PGHOST","PGHOSTADDR","PGPORT","PGDATABASE","PGUSER","PGSERVICE","PGSERVICEFILE"):
        env.pop(key,None)
    for setting,param in (("PGHOST","host"),("PGPORT","port"),("PGUSER","user"),("PGPASSWORD","password")):
        if params.get(param) is not None:env[setting]=str(params[param])
    path=TASK/"pre-release.dump"
    with secure_open(path) as output:
        result=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/pg_dump","--format=custom","--no-owner","--no-acl",str(identity[0])],env=env,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert result.returncode==0,"Backup failed; retain partial artifact privately, do not release"
    toc=TASK/"pre-release.toc"
    with secure_open(toc) as output:
        result=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/pg_restore","--list",str(path)],stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert result.returncode==0 and path.stat().st_size>0 and toc.stat().st_size>0
    receipt={"candidate":CANDIDATE,"before":BEFORE,"database_fingerprint_sha256":approval["database_fingerprint_sha256"],
             "backup_sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"toc_sha256":hashlib.sha256(toc.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
             "backup_bytes":path.stat().st_size,"mode":"0600","restore_performed":False}
    with secure_open(TASK/"backup-receipt.json") as output:output.write(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2).encode())
    print("REMAINING_ITEMS_BACKUP_VERIFIED",receipt["backup_sha256"],receipt["backup_bytes"])

"""Guarded whole-chain upgrade; production entry requires a separately recorded approval."""
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path("/home/evennia/testing/fusion2")
TASK=Path("/home/evennia/testing/.remaining-items-20261026-2259c9")
CANDIDATE="4347e76b046d2c59bd8bcf1eabe3535ebeaa95a9"
BEFORE="0058_necrozma_integrity"
TARGET="0059_owned_trained_stat_nature"
class RehearsalRollback(RuntimeError):
    """Deliberate local-only outer-transaction rollback probe."""
def upgrade(*,fail_after=False):
    """Apply the complete remaining Pokemon chain in one PostgreSQL transaction."""
    from django.core.management import call_command
    from django.db import connection,transaction
    from django.db.migrations.recorder import MigrationRecorder
    assert connection.vendor=="postgresql"
    latest=MigrationRecorder.Migration.objects.filter(app="pokemon").order_by("-name").values_list("name",flat=True).first()
    assert latest==BEFORE, "Unexpected predecessor; refuse instead of repairing data"
    with transaction.atomic():
        call_command("migrate","pokemon",TARGET,interactive=False,verbosity=1)
        latest=MigrationRecorder.Migration.objects.filter(app="pokemon").order_by("-name").values_list("name",flat=True).first()
        assert latest==TARGET
        if fail_after:raise RehearsalRollback("Probe after full chain and post_migrate, before outer commit")
def authorize():
    """Require exact human-authorized target, source and database identity."""
    assert Path.cwd().resolve()==ROOT and TASK.resolve()==TASK
    os.umask(0o077)
    approval=json.loads((TASK/"operator-approval.json").read_text())
    assert approval["approved"] is True and approval["candidate"]==CANDIDATE
    reviewed=(TASK/"reviewed-plan.json").read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(reviewed).hexdigest()==approval["reviewed_plan_sha256"]
    plan=json.loads(reviewed)
    assert plan["candidate"]==CANDIDATE and plan["scope"]==approval["scope"]
    for name,item in plan["controllers"].items():
        path=TASK/name
        assert path.resolve().parent==TASK
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n",b"\n")).hexdigest()==item["sha256_lf"]
    assert approval["scope"]=="PF2-Dev remaining item release, Pokemon0059, ten finite sources and separate tagged ordinary QA only"
    assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()==CANDIDATE
    assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain"],cwd=ROOT,text=True)
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
    os.environ["DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE"]="server.conf.settings"
    os.environ["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"]="1"
    import django
    django.setup()
    from django.db import connection
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SELECT current_database(),current_user,current_schema(),inet_server_addr()::text,inet_server_port()")
        values=cursor.fetchone()
    digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(values).encode()).hexdigest()
    assert digest==approval["database_fingerprint_sha256"]
    import pokemon
    assert Path(pokemon.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
if __name__=="__main__":
    assert sys.argv[1:]==["--apply-approved"]
    authorize()
    upgrade()
    print("REMAINING_ITEMS_ATOMIC_UPGRADE_COMMITTED",CANDIDATE,TARGET)

"""Reviewed finite source installation; this template is not an authorization."""

import hashlib
import json
import socket
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def protected_digest():
    """Read private owned/custody/account state, publishing only a comparison hash."""
    from evennia.accounts.models import AccountDB
    from pokemon.models.core import OwnedPokemon
    from pokemon.models.trainer import Trainer
    from pokemon.models.storage import PokemonPlacement, UserStorage
    from pokemon.models.moves import ActiveMoveslot, Moveset, MovesetSlot, PokemonLearnedMove, MovePPBoost

    models = (AccountDB, OwnedPokemon, Trainer, PokemonPlacement, UserStorage,
              ActiveMoveslot, Moveset, MovesetSlot, PokemonLearnedMove, MovePPBoost)
    data = {model._meta.label: list(model.objects.order_by("pk").values()) for model in models}
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(data, default=str, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()


def recipes():
    """Name exactly seven accepted finite batches and three explicit item counters."""
    from pokemon.services.finite_item_supply import FINITE_SUPPLY_ROUTES
    from pokemon.services.item_counter import ItemCounter

    result = []
    for issue in range(877, 884):
        route = FINITE_SUPPLY_ROUTES[issue]
        result.append((issue, route.marker, route, route.recipe()))
    for issue, filename in ((893, "berry_seed_counter.json"), (896, "exp_candy_counter.json"),
                            (904, "nature_mint_counter.json")):
        route = ItemCounter("world/" + filename)
        data = route.recipe()
        result.append((issue, "counter_" + data["key"], route, data))
    assert len(result) == 10
    assert sum(len(data["offers"]) for _, _, _, data in result) == 66
    assert len({data["entrance"] for _, _, _, data in result}) == 10
    return result


def install_sources(hub, *, prior=None, fail_after=None):
    """Install/retry as one transaction; never infer stock, reset it or touch old sources."""
    from django.db import transaction
    from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB
    from pokemon.services.battle_rewards import BattleRewards
    from pokemon.services.item_supply import ItemSupplyRoute

    before = protected_digest()
    rows = []
    try:
        with transaction.atomic():
            hub = ObjectDB.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=hub.pk)
            original = BattleRewards.stored_attribute(hub, ItemSupplyRoute.marker)
            original_room = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=original["room"]) if original else None
            original_stock = (BattleRewards.stored_attribute(original_room, "store_inventory")
                              if original_room else None)
            for index, (issue, marker_name, route, data) in enumerate(recipes(), 1):
                previous = BattleRewards.stored_attribute(hub, marker_name)
                old_stock = None
                if prior is not None:
                    previous_record = next(row for row in prior if row["issue"] == issue)
                    assert dict(previous or {}) == previous_record["marker"]
                    old_room = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=previous_record["room"])
                    old_stock = BattleRewards.stored_attribute(old_room, "store_inventory")
                room = route.install(hub)
                marker = dict(BattleRewards.stored_attribute(hub, marker_name))
                stock = BattleRewards.stored_attribute(room, "store_inventory")
                stock = {name: dict(value) for name, value in stock.items()}
                assert marker["room"] == room.pk
                assert BattleRewards.stored_attribute(room, "store_buy_only") is True
                if prior is not None:
                    assert room.pk == previous_record["room"] and stock == old_stock
                rows.append(dict(issue=issue, room=room.pk, marker_name=marker_name,
                                 marker=marker, recipe=data, stock=stock))
                if fail_after == index:
                    raise RuntimeError("Isolated installer rollback fixture")
            assert BattleRewards.stored_attribute(hub, ItemSupplyRoute.marker) == original
            if original_room:
                assert BattleRewards.stored_attribute(original_room, "store_inventory") == original_stock
            assert protected_digest() == before
    finally:
        hub.attributes.reset_cache()
    return dict(sources=rows, protected_digest_before=before, protected_digest_after=protected_digest(),
                original_supply_unchanged=True, automatic_refill=False, permanent=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from atomic_upgrade import authorize, TASK, CANDIDATE

    assert sys.argv[1:] in (["--install-approved"], ["--retry-approved"])
    retry = sys.argv[1] == "--retry-approved"
    authorize()
    import evennia

    evennia._init()
    from django.conf import settings
    from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB

    if not retry:
        with socket.socket() as probe:
            probe.settimeout(1)
            assert probe.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", int(settings.AMP_PORT))) != 0
    prior = json.loads((TASK / "source-install-receipt.json").read_text())["sources"] if retry else None
    result = install_sources(ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=31, db_key="Alpha Test Hub"), prior=prior)
    result.update(candidate=CANDIDATE, hub=31, no_existing_human_data_changed=True)
    path = TASK / ("source-retry-receipt.json" if retry else "source-install-receipt.json")
    assert not path.exists()
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print("ITEM_COUNTERS_INSTALLED", CANDIDATE, "ten finite sources; no refill")

"""Separate approved QA sources/wallets; ordinary players obtain every creature/item."""

import json
import socket
import sys


def write_once(path, value):
    """Private controller receipts are never silently replaced."""
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(value, indent=2, default=str) + "\n")


def world(plan):
    """Author only the exact tagged private helper locations in the reviewed plan."""
    from atomic_upgrade import TASK, CANDIDATE
    from django.conf import settings
    from django.db import transaction
    from evennia.accounts.models import AccountDB
    from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB
    from evennia.utils.create import create_object

    tag, names = plan["tagged_qa"]["tag"], plan["tagged_qa"]["ordinary_player_names"]
    assert len(names) == 4 and len(set(names)) == 4
    assert not (TASK / "qa-world-receipt.json").exists()
    assert not AccountDB.objects.filter(username__in=names).exists()
    assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_tags__db_key=tag).exists()
    assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_location_id=2, db_key__iexact="itemqa").exists()
    with socket.socket() as probe:
        probe.settimeout(1)
        assert probe.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", int(settings.AMP_PORT))) != 0
    guard = "tag(" + tag + ") and (" + " or ".join("attr(key," + name + ")" for name in names) + ")"
    with transaction.atomic():
        center = create_object("typeclasses.rooms.Room", key="Remaining Items Tagged QA Center", nohome=True)
        center.db.desc = "Private item QA prerequisites. +store offers finite helpers; +heal is ordinary Center recovery. Named trails provide base sources. limbo returns."
        center.db.is_pokemon_center = True
        center.db.is_item_shop = center.db.store_buy_only = True
        center.db.noitem, center.db.allow_hunting = True, False
        center.db.store_inventory = {row["item"]: {"price": row["price"], "quantity": row["quantity"]}
                                     for row in plan["tagged_qa"]["helper_offers"]}
        rooms = [center]
        links = [("itemqa", ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=2), center), ("limbo", center, ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=2))]
        for source in plan["tagged_qa"]["base_sources"]:
            room = create_object("typeclasses.rooms.Room", key="Remaining Items Tagged " + source["key"], nohome=True)
            room.db.desc = "Private native hunt/capture source; center returns."
            room.db.allow_hunting, room.db.noitem = True, True
            room.db.npc_chance, room.db.encounter_rate, room.db.tp_cost = 0, 100, 0
            room.db.hunt_chart = [{"name": source["species"], "min_level": source["level"],
                                  "max_level": source["level"], "weight": 1}]
            rooms.append(room)
            links.extend([(source["key"], center, room), ("center", room, center)])
        exits = []
        for key, origin, destination in links:
            obj = create_object("typeclasses.exits.Exit", key=key, location=origin, destination=destination, nohome=True)
            obj.locks.add("traverse:" + guard + ";view:" + guard + ";teleport_here:false()")
            exits.append(obj)
        for room in rooms:
            room.locks.add("view:" + guard + ";teleport_here:false()")
        for obj in rooms + exits:
            obj.tags.add(tag)
        record = dict(candidate=CANDIDATE, tag=tag, names=names, center=center.pk,
                      objects=[dict(id=obj.pk, key=obj.key, typeclass=obj.db_typeclass_path,
                                    location=obj.db_location_id, destination=obj.db_destination_id,
                                    locks=obj.db_lock_storage) for obj in rooms + exits],
                      helper_stock=dict(center.db.store_inventory), sources=plan["tagged_qa"]["base_sources"],
                      direct_pokemon_move_or_item_grants=0, ordinary_accounts_created=False)
    write_once(TASK / "qa-world-receipt.json", record)
    return record


def players(plan):
    """Tag four newly onboarded ordinary Players and label only their fixture wallets."""
    from atomic_upgrade import TASK, CANDIDATE
    from django.db import transaction
    from evennia.accounts.models import AccountDB
    from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB
    from pokemon.models.core import OwnedPokemon
    from pokemon.models.onboarding import OnboardingCompletion
    from pokemon.models.trainer import Trainer

    tag, names = plan["tagged_qa"]["tag"], plan["tagged_qa"]["ordinary_player_names"]
    assert not (TASK / "qa-player-prerequisites.json").exists()
    records = []
    with transaction.atomic():
        for name in names:
            account = AccountDB.objects.get(username=name)
            player = ObjectDB.objects.get(db_key=name, db_typeclass_path="pokemon.user.User")
            assert player.account.pk == account.pk and not account.is_superuser
            assert set(player.permissions.all()) == set(account.permissions.all()) == {"player"}
            assert OnboardingCompletion.objects.filter(character=player).count() == 1
            assert OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(trainer__user=player).count() == 1
            assert not player.db.battle_id and not player.db.battle_lock
            trainer = Trainer.objects.select_for_update().get(user=player)
            assert trainer.money == 0 and not trainer.list_inventory()
            money = plan["tagged_qa"]["fixture_wallet_each"]
            assert type(money) is int and money == 1000000
            Trainer.objects.filter(pk=trainer.pk).update(money=money)
            player.tags.add(tag)
            account.tags.add(tag)
            records.append(dict(name=name, player=player.pk, account=account.pk, trainer=trainer.pk,
                                before_money=0, fixture_money=money, ordinary_permissions_unchanged=True,
                                onboarding_pokemon=[str(pk) for pk in OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(trainer=trainer).values_list("pk", flat=True)]))
    result = dict(candidate=CANDIDATE, tag=tag, kind="separate labelled ordinary QA wallets", players=records,
                  direct_pokemon_move_or_item_grants=0)
    write_once(TASK / "qa-player-prerequisites.json", result)
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from atomic_upgrade import authorize, TASK

    authorize()
    import evennia

    evennia._init()
    plan = json.loads((TASK / "reviewed-plan.json").read_text())
    assert sys.argv[1:] in (["--world-approved"], ["--players-approved"])
    result = world(plan) if sys.argv[1] == "--world-approved" else players(plan)
    print("TAGGED_ITEM_QA_PREPARED", result["candidate"], result["tag"], "no source, move or item grants")

prerequisites.py.source:
"""Label only reviewed depleted/status prerequisites on newly captured QA-owned targets."""

import json
import sys


def apply_prerequisite(plan, people, request):
    """No genetics, moves, abilities, EVs, training, clocks or item effects may be set."""
    from django.db import transaction
    from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB
    from pokemon.helpers.pokemon_helpers import get_max_hp
    from pokemon.models.core import OwnedPokemon
    from pokemon.models.moves import ActiveMoveslot, MovesetSlot, PokemonLearnedMove
    from pokemon.models.necrozma import NecrozmaCombination
    from pokemon.models.storage import CaptureReceipt
    from pokemon.services.ownership import locked_owners, assert_character_free

    assert set(request) == {"request_id", "player", "pokemon", "kind", "value"}
    assert request["kind"] in {"hp0", "hp_deficit", "pp0", "status"}
    records = people["players"]
    names = plan["tagged_qa"]["ordinary_player_names"]
    assert [row["name"] for row in records] == names
    record = next(row for row in records if row["name"] == request["player"])
    actorids = {row["player"] for row in records}
    tag = plan["tagged_qa"]["tag"]
    player = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=record["player"], db_key=record["name"], db_tags__db_key=tag)
    assert player.db_account_id == record["account"] and not player.account.is_superuser
    with locked_owners((player.pk,)) as (characters, storages, trainers):
        assert_character_free(characters[player.pk])
        mon = OwnedPokemon.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=request["pokemon"], trainer=trainers[player.pk])
        assert not mon.is_egg and mon.obtained_method == "caught"
        assert mon.original_trainer and mon.original_trainer.user_id in actorids
        assert CaptureReceipt.objects.filter(owned_id=mon.pk, storage__user_id__in=actorids).exists()
        assert not NecrozmaCombination.objects.filter(companion_id=mon.pk).exists()
        before = OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(pk=mon.pk).values().get()
        pp_before = list(ActiveMoveslot.objects.filter(pokemon=mon).order_by("slot").values())
        changed = set()
        if request["kind"] == "hp0":
            assert request["value"] is None and mon.current_hp > 0
            mon.current_hp = 0
            changed.add("current_hp")
        elif request["kind"] == "hp_deficit":
            deficit = request["value"]
            maximum = get_max_hp(mon)
            assert type(deficit) is int and 1 <= deficit < maximum
            target = maximum - deficit
            assert 0 < target <= mon.current_hp
            mon.current_hp = target
            changed.add("current_hp")
        elif request["kind"] == "status":
            assert request["value"] in {"psn", "par", "slp", "brn", "frz"}
            assert mon.status in ("", None, 0) and mon.current_hp > 0
            mon.status = request["value"]
            mon.sleep_turns = 3 if mon.status == "slp" else None
            changed.update(("status", "sleep_turns"))
        else:
            selected = request["value"]
            assert isinstance(selected, list) and selected and len(selected) == len(set(selected))
            assert all(type(slot) is int and 1 <= slot <= 4 for slot in selected)
            pair = NecrozmaCombination.objects.filter(host_id=mon.pk).first()
            assert pair is None or pair.move_slot not in selected
            slots = list(ActiveMoveslot.objects.select_for_update().filter(pokemon=mon, slot__in=selected))
            assert len(slots) == len(selected)
            learned = set(PokemonLearnedMove.objects.filter(pokemon=mon).values_list("move_id", flat=True))
            canonical = dict(MovesetSlot.objects.filter(moveset_id=mon.active_moveset_id).values_list("slot", "move_id"))
            for slot in slots:
                assert canonical[slot.slot] == slot.move_id and slot.move_id in learned
                slot.current_pp = 0
                slot.save(update_fields=["current_pp"])
        if changed:
            mon.save(update_fields=sorted(changed))
        after = OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(pk=mon.pk).values().get()
        assert all(after[key] == value for key, value in before.items() if key not in changed)
        pp_after = list(ActiveMoveslot.objects.filter(pokemon=mon).order_by("slot").values())
        if request["kind"] != "pp0":
            assert pp_after == pp_before
        result = dict(request=request, label="separate explicitly approved QA prerequisite; not an earned condition or item effect",
                      before=before, after=after, pp_before=pp_before, pp_after=pp_after,
                      genetics_moves_abilities_training_and_clocks_changed=False)
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from atomic_upgrade import authorize, TASK, CANDIDATE

    assert len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[1] == "--prerequisite-approved"
    authorize()
    import evennia
    from uuid import UUID

    evennia._init()
    request_id = str(UUID(sys.argv[2]))
    request = json.loads((TASK / ("prerequisite-request-" + request_id + ".json")).read_text())
    assert request["request_id"] == request_id
    path = TASK / ("prerequisite-receipt-" + request_id + ".json")
    assert not path.exists()
    plan = json.loads((TASK / "reviewed-plan.json").read_text())
    people = json.loads((TASK / "qa-player-prerequisites.json").read_text())
    result = apply_prerequisite(plan, people, request)
    result["candidate"] = CANDIDATE
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2, default=str) + "\n")
    print("TAGGED_QA_PREREQUISITE_ONLY", CANDIDATE, request["kind"], request_id)

"""Remove only receipted new QA identities/private objects while the game is stopped."""

import hashlib
import json
import socket
import sys


def port_open(port):
    """Require the exact stopped instance before removing its temporary fixtures."""
    with socket.socket() as probe:
        probe.settimeout(1)
        return probe.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) == 0


def remove_qa(plan, players, world):
    """Collector proof and all-table comparison refuse any non-QA cascade/write."""
    from django.apps import apps
    from django.db import connection, transaction
    from django.db.models import Q
    from django.db.models.deletion import Collector
    from evennia.accounts.models import AccountDB
    from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB
    from evennia.typeclasses.models import Attribute, Tag
    from pokemon.models.breeding import BreedingCycle, BreedingEgg
    from pokemon.models.core import OwnedPokemon
    from pokemon.models.daycare import DaycareEntry
    from pokemon.models.market import MarketListing
    from pokemon.models.necrozma import NecrozmaCombination
    from pokemon.models.onboarding import OnboardingCompletion
    from pokemon.models.ownership import OwnershipTransfer, PokemonReservation
    from pokemon.models.storage import PokemonPlacement

    tag = plan["tagged_qa"]["tag"]
    names = plan["tagged_qa"]["ordinary_player_names"]
    assert players["tag"] == world["tag"] == tag
    assert [row["name"] for row in players["players"]] == names
    actorids = {row["player"] for row in players["players"]}
    accountids = {row["account"] for row in players["players"]}
    privateids = actorids | {row["id"] for row in world["objects"]}
    assert len(actorids) == len(accountids) == 4

    with transaction.atomic():
        list(ObjectDB.objects.select_for_update().filter(pk__in=privateids).order_by("pk"))
        for row in players["players"]:
            actor = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=row["player"], db_key=row["name"], db_tags__db_key=tag)
            account = AccountDB.objects.get(pk=row["account"], username=row["name"], db_tags__db_key=tag)
            assert actor.db_account_id == account.pk and not account.is_superuser
            assert not account.db_is_connected and not actor.db.battle_id and not actor.db.battle_lock
            assert not actor.contents
        assert set(ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_tags__db_key=tag).values_list("pk", flat=True)) == privateids
        assert set(AccountDB.objects.filter(db_tags__db_key=tag).values_list("pk", flat=True)) == accountids
        assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_account_id__in=accountids).exclude(pk__in=actorids).exists()
        for row in world["objects"]:
            obj = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=row["id"], db_key=row["key"])
            assert obj.db_typeclass_path == row["typeclass"]
            assert obj.db_location_id == row["location"] and obj.db_destination_id == row["destination"]
            assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(Q(db_location_id=obj.pk) | Q(db_destination_id=obj.pk) | Q(db_home_id=obj.pk)).exclude(pk__in=privateids).exists()
        owned = OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(trainer__user_id__in=actorids)
        ownedids = set(owned.values_list("pk", flat=True))
        assert not NecrozmaCombination.objects.filter(Q(host_id__in=ownedids) | Q(companion_id__in=ownedids)).exists()
        assert not PokemonReservation.objects.filter(pokemon_id__in=ownedids).exists()
        assert not PokemonPlacement.objects.filter(pokemon_id__in=ownedids).exclude(location_type__in=("party", "box")).exists()
        assert not DaycareEntry.objects.filter(storage__user_id__in=actorids, state="active").exists()
        assert not owned.exclude(held_item="").exclude(held_item__isnull=True).exists()
        cycles = BreedingCycle.objects.filter(origin_character_id__in=actorids)
        assert not cycles.filter(state="producing").exists()
        eggs = BreedingEgg.objects.filter(cycle__in=cycles)
        assert not eggs.exclude(pokemon_id__in=ownedids).exclude(pokemon__isnull=True).exists()
        listings = MarketListing.objects.filter(seller_character_id__in=actorids)
        assert not listings.filter(state="active").exists()
        assert not listings.exclude(buyer_character_id__in=actorids).exclude(buyer_character_id__isnull=True).exists()
        transfers = OwnershipTransfer.objects.filter(Q(proposer_id__in=actorids) | Q(recipient_id__in=actorids))
        assert not transfers.exclude(proposer_id__in=actorids).exists()
        assert not transfers.exclude(recipient_id__in=actorids).exists()
        assert not transfers.filter(state="pending").exists()
        onboarding = OnboardingCompletion.objects.filter(origin_character_id__in=actorids)
        assert onboarding.count() == 4
        objects = list(ObjectDB.objects.filter(pk__in=privateids))
        accounts = list(AccountDB.objects.filter(pk__in=accountids))
        tags = list(Tag.objects.filter(db_key=tag))
        attrids = {attr.pk for obj in objects + accounts for attr in obj.db_attributes.all()}
        models = [model for model in apps.get_models(include_auto_created=True)
                  if model._meta.managed and not model._meta.proxy]

        def snapshot():
            """Keep full private row values only in memory for this atomic comparison."""
            return {model._meta.db_table: (model._meta.pk.attname,
                    list(model._base_manager.order_by("pk").values())) for model in models}

        all_before = snapshot()
        manual = {}
        # PROTECT is deliberate for real histories. Remove only explicitly selected
        # closed QA receipts first; the all-row comparison still covers this phase.
        for queryset in (eggs, listings, transfers, onboarding):
            manual.setdefault(queryset.model._meta.db_table, set()).update(queryset.values_list("pk", flat=True))
            queryset.delete()
        collector = Collector(using="default")
        collector.collect(list(owned))
        collector.collect(objects)
        collector.collect(accounts)
        collector.collect(list(cycles))
        collector.collect(tags)

        def deletions():
            """Resolve exact affected model PKs, including automatic relation tables."""
            result = {table: set(ids) for table, ids in manual.items()}
            for model, rows in list(collector.data.items()) + [(qs.model, qs) for qs in collector.fast_deletes]:
                result.setdefault(model._meta.db_table, set()).update(row.pk for row in rows)
            return result

        planned = deletions()
        # Delete only attributes whose every FK link is already in the QA deletion set.
        removable = []
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            refs = []
            for table in connection.introspection.table_names(cursor):
                constraints = connection.introspection.get_constraints(cursor, table)
                pkcols = next((value["columns"] for value in constraints.values() if value.get("primary_key")), [])
                for value in constraints.values():
                    if value.get("foreign_key") == ("typeclasses_attribute", "id"):
                        assert len(pkcols) == 1
                        refs.append((table, value["columns"][0], pkcols[0]))
            for identifier in attrids:
                safe = True
                for table, column, pkcol in refs:
                    quote = connection.ops.quote_name
                    cursor.execute("SELECT " + quote(pkcol) + " FROM " + quote(table) + " WHERE " + quote(column) + "=%s", [identifier])
                    if not {row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()} <= planned.get(table, set()):
                        safe = False
                        break
                if safe:
                    removable.append(identifier)
        collector.collect(list(Attribute.objects.filter(pk__in=removable)))
        planned = deletions()
        assert planned.get("objects_objectdb", set()) <= privateids
        assert planned.get("accounts_accountdb", set()) <= accountids
        assert planned.get("pokemon_ownedpokemon", set()) <= ownedids

        def protected(data):
            """Every row outside the exact deletion set must retain all its fields."""
            result = {}
            for table, (pk, rows) in data.items():
                excluded = {str(value) for value in planned.get(table, set())}
                result[table] = [row for row in rows if str(row[pk]) not in excluded]
            return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()

        before = protected(all_before)
        collector.delete()
        after = protected(snapshot())
        assert after == before
        assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(pk__in=privateids).exists()
        assert not AccountDB.objects.filter(pk__in=accountids).exists()
        assert not OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(pk__in=ownedids).exists()
        assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_tags__db_key=tag).exists()
        result = dict(removed_accounts=sorted(accountids), removed_objects=sorted(privateids),
                      removed_pokemon=sorted(map(str, ownedids)), protected_digest_before=before,
                      protected_digest_after=after, all_other_rows_unchanged=True,
                      refunds=False, refill=False, public_sources_removed=False)
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from atomic_upgrade import authorize, TASK, CANDIDATE

    assert sys.argv[1:] == ["--cleanup-approved"]
    authorize()
    import evennia

    evennia._init()
    assert all(not port_open(port) for port in (4000, 4001, 4002, 4005, 4006))
    plan = json.loads((TASK / "reviewed-plan.json").read_text())
    players = json.loads((TASK / "qa-player-prerequisites.json").read_text())
    world = json.loads((TASK / "qa-world-receipt.json").read_text())
    result = remove_qa(plan, players, world)
    result["candidate"] = CANDIDATE
    with (TASK / "qa-cleanup-receipt.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print("TAGGED_QA_REMOVED", CANDIDATE, "all other rows and public stock preserved")

limits: Empty maintenance windows and exact source/database/schema/marker/port checks are required before both Evennia stop/start cycles
No PostgreSQL/nginx/host restart, sudo, package installation, manual project source edit or human fixture use
Original six-item Supply Corner, other existing sources/markers and legitimate sold stock are preserved; no refill opt-in
Separate tagged setup/prerequisites and ordinary socket commands; no shared-world rollback/concurrency fault injection
Four real elapsed hours cannot be replaced by altered clocks or an automated controlled-clock test
After committed0059 never automatically reverse schema, downgrade source or restore the backup; stop for review on unexpected state
Cleanup deletes only receipted new QA identities/private objects and their exact closed receipts; all other rows and permanent sales survive
Public finite quantities may be depleted by legitimate QA or human sales; report actual remaining stock without replenishing
